def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_State_Rankings_Identity_Theft_Reports.csv"

    # Structure (from inspection):
    # row 0: title, row 1: blank, row 2: header, row 3+: data
    raw = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="cp1252", header=None)

    header_row = 2
    raw.columns = raw.iloc[header_row].tolist()
    df = raw.iloc[header_row + 1 :].copy()

    # Keep only data rows with numeric Rank (drops blanks/footers)
    df = df[df["Rank"].astype(str).str.match(r"^\d+$", na=False)].copy()

    # Clean numeric columns
    df["Reports per 100K Population"] = (
        df["Reports per 100K Population"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False).astype(float)
    )
    df["# of Reports"] = df["# of Reports"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False).astype(int)

    return df[["State", "Reports per 100K Population", "# of Reports"]].reset_index(drop=True)

def process(identityTheft, fraudOther) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    it = identityTheft.rename(
        columns={
            "Reports per 100K Population": "itReportsPer100k",
            "# of Reports": "itReports",
        }
    )
    fo = fraudOther.rename(
        columns={
            "Reports per 100K Population": "foReportsPer100k",
            "# of Reports": "foReports",
        }
    )

    merged = it.merge(fo, on="State", how="outer", validate="one_to_one")

    # If a state is missing from one table, treat missing report counts as 0
    merged[["itReports", "foReports"]] = merged[["itReports", "foReports"]].fillna(0)

    merged["totalReports"] = merged["itReports"] + merged["foReports"]

    # Derive population from per-100k rate and report count when possible, then compute combined density.
    # Use the fraud/other-derived population if available; else use identity-theft-derived.
    merged["popFromFo"] = merged.apply(
        lambda r: (r["foReports"] / r["foReportsPer100k"] * 100000) if pd.notna(r.get("foReportsPer100k")) and r["foReportsPer100k"] not in [0, None] and r["foReports"] > 0 else pd.NA,
        axis=1,
    )
    merged["popFromIt"] = merged.apply(
        lambda r: (r["itReports"] / r["itReportsPer100k"] * 100000) if pd.notna(r.get("itReportsPer100k")) and r["itReportsPer100k"] not in [0, None] and r["itReports"] > 0 else pd.NA,
        axis=1,
    )
    merged["population"] = merged["popFromFo"].fillna(merged["popFromIt"])

    merged["totalReportsPer100k"] = merged["totalReports"] / merged["population"] * 100000

    out = merged[["State", "totalReportsPer100k", "totalReports", "population"]].copy()
    out = out.sort_values("totalReportsPer100k", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Outer-join identityTheft and fraudOther on State (one-to-one); rename per-100k and report-count columns to it*/fo*; fill missing report counts with 0; compute totalReports = itReports+foReports; derive population from available (reports / per100k * 100000) preferring fraud/other then identity theft; compute combined density totalReportsPer100k = totalReports/population*100000; sort descending by totalReportsPer100k
